{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.22

|gr1= Vehicle Inventory

|descr=Returns an array of subarrays with the type names and ammo left of all the vehicle's cargo or container magazines.

|s1= [[magazinesAmmoCargo]] vehicle

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Array]]s with [class, ammo]

* ammo: [[Number]] - Number of rounds loaded

|x1= <sqf>magazinesAmmoCargo vehicle player;</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>magazinesAmmoCargo uniformContainer player;</sqf>
